items.title: Inside CEO Cristiano Amon’s vision for Qualcomm’s future
items.summary: CEO Cristiano Amon is betting that Qualcomm's next act goes far beyond mobile technology. From grocery stores that bring the physical world online to breakthroughs in 6G, robotics, and data centers, Amon is leading the company into a future built on its innovation tradition.
